legacy_cells.B: SMILE: Smart Monitoring Intelligent Learning engine. An Ontology-based Context-aware system for supporting patients subjected to severe Emergencies
legacy_cells.C: Malak Khareis, Iyad Zaarour, and Hamid Mcheick
legacy_cells.E: international journal of healthcare technology and management
legacy_cells.I: 026_2016_SMILE smart monitoring intelligent learning engine - An ontology-based context-aware system for supporting patients subjected to severe emergencies.pdf
legacy_cells.O: Heart-related emergencies (including heart attack); high blood pressure and elevated HDL cholesterol (motivating scenario)
legacy_cells.FL: Proposed three-layer system: context acquisition (sensors) → context processing (ontology/context knowledge base with ontology and Bayesian reasoning) → service presentation/decision manager; no demonstrated temporal-transition or planning module.
legacy_cells.FM: Proposes an ontology-based probabilistic context-aware middleware framework for emergency monitoring/response and lifestyle-oriented emergency prevention, using confidence levels, influence diagrams, and AHP for service decisions.
legacy_cells.FO: The authors identify recognizing multiple activities as a main limitation.
legacy_cells.FP: Experiment with real data and complete the system implementation; investigate Dynamic Bayesian Networks to predict user activities, including abnormal/emergency activities.
legacy_cells.FQ: The authors frame a need to remotely monitor and protect heart patients at home by combining emergency detection/response with emergency-prevention lifestyle support.
legacy_cells.FR: Evidence boundary: conceptual framework only; the authors defer implementation and real-data experiments, and activity forecasting to future work. No temporal world-model transition, action-conditioned rollouts, planning outcomes, or clinical benefit is demonstrated.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M9 Safety & governance; M10 Clinician interface & lifecycle
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Carry the paper’s governance and evaluation considerations into a separate safety/lifecycle service; they do not validate a dynamics model.
legacy_cells.FU: Reviewer mapping (KB §20): Prospective evaluation & lifecycle governance
legacy_cells.FX: Complete extracted text, PDF pp. 1–13: title page and abstract (p. 1); Introduction and motivation scenario (pp. 2–3); architecture and context-processing/ontology/Bayesian methods (pp. 3–7); service presentation, Table 1, and decision-making methods (pp. 7–10); conclusion and future work (p. 11); references (pp. 12–13). No separate Results or Limitations section is present; relevant Table 1 was read. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: Corrected B and C because the PDF title-page wording/byline directly differs from the prefilled metadata; all other A:I fields were left untouched. Included only as a supporting semantic-context/uncertainty component, not as a core world model. This is a conceptual proposal, not an evaluated implementation; no data experiments or quantitative results are reported, and implementation plus dynamic activity prediction are future work. M is inapplicable because the paper is included. Evidence QA: 21/21 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (100%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 23 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 0 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: No independent human review or reproduction.
